# netgear_device (Data Source)

Reads information about the access point.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netgear_device" "this" {}

output "firmware_version" {
  value = data.netgear_device.this.firmware_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Configured country/region.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS servers.
- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 default gateway.
- `id` (String) The serial number.
- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address of the management interface.
- `lan_mac_address` (String) MAC address of the LAN interface.
- `model` (String) Model name, e.g. `WAX210`.
- `name` (String) AP name.
- `netmask` (String) IPv4 netmask of the management interface.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number.
- `wlan_2g_mac_address` (String) MAC address of the 2.4 GHz radio.
- `wlan_5g_mac_address` (String) MAC address of the 5 GHz radio.
